name: David Chen
bio: David covers civil litigation and rights-related court opinions, including discrimination claims, wrongful conviction cases, police accountability, and disability rights.

name: Elena Vasquez
bio: Elena focuses on appellate court rulings and constitutional questions. Her coverage spans SCOTUS opinions, civil rights litigation, voting rights, and environmental law across all federal circuits.

name: Marcus Webb
bio: Marcus reports on criminal court proceedings across federal and state jurisdictions. His beat includes sentencing, death penalty cases, federal indictments, and white-collar crime prosecutions.

name: Rachel Torres
bio: Rachel covers labor law, union organizing, and workplace disputes for LAWS.com. She has reviewed and summarized hundreds of federal and state court opinions on employment matters since joining the LAWS.com News Desk.

name: James Park
bio: James tracks business litigation and intellectual property disputes. His beat covers SEC enforcement, antitrust actions, bankruptcy proceedings, and corporate governance cases.

name: Sarah Mitchell
bio: Sarah summarizes regulatory decisions and policy-related court filings. Her coverage includes education law, healthcare regulation, immigration cases, and FDA enforcement actions.
